resources.string: Tap START and speak into your phone
You\'re live, speak into your phone\nApp delay: %1$d ms (Bluetooth adds more)
Live Mic needs microphone permission to work. Allow it in Settings > Apps > Live Mic > Permissions.
Connect your Bluetooth speaker in your phone\'s Bluetooth settings first. Without it, sound comes out of the phone itself and will squeal.
Tip: if the speaker squeals, step away from it or lower the volume boost.
Android only lets the phone\'s Settings app change the Bluetooth codec, so Live Mic takes you there. SBC often has less delay than AAC.
Connect your Bluetooth speaker first. Without it, every codec is greyed out.

Live Mic will jump to Bluetooth audio codec in Developer options (if your phone doesn\'t jump there, scroll down to Networking). Tap it, choose SBC, then turn the speaker off and on so it reconnects.\n\nIf only SBC can be selected, your speaker is already using it.
Developer options are turned off. On the next screen, tap Build number 7 times, then come back and tap this button again.
Your phone\'s mic is playing through the speaker
